name: idtap-contract

versionPolicy.assert: Each implementation keeps a constant CONTRACT_VERSION and asserts it equals contract.json `version` in its conformance suite (see README 'Versioning').
versionPolicy.minor: bumped when wire semantics change (a client built against an older minor must not load newer data without the matching heal); clients assert exact match.
versionPolicy.patch: reserved for fixture/doc additions that change no semantics.

changelog.0.3.0: PROP-7 Piece.system {pitch, phonology, rhythm, display} (absent = Hindustani); PROP-8 Phrase.syllables (anchor {traj, t=0}, onset/nucleus/coda/tone keys, lyric + sung vowels with provenance), normative heal (firstTrajIdxs rule) and projection (dual-write of the legacy per-trajectory fields), re-homing after phrase edits, load invariants, and the pre-0.3.0 write guard; PROP-9 phoneme packs as data (packs/*.json, pack.schema.json: hindi-urdu, jyutping, kurmanji). Piece.lyricsText added. Amended 2026-11-13, before any client released 0.3.0: syllables live on vocal tracks only (heal and projection leave non-vocal tracks as stored); X-IDTAP-Client format and the 409 write-guard refusal; legacy_safe skips phrases with no stored tier.
changelog.0.2.0: PROP-6 vibrato v2: vibObj is {rate, extentStart, extentEnd, vertOffset, phase}; v1 {periods, vertOffset, initUp, extent} accepted as LEGACY and healed losslessly; canonical form emits vibObj only when id == 13 (PROP-6b).
changelog.0.1.0: initial contract: PROP-1 ruleSet, PROP-2 dates/collections, PROP-3 chikari; 10 entities.

description: Language-neutral serialization contract (JSON Schemas + golden fixtures) for the IDTAP data model, shared by idtap (TS), idtap-api (Python) and idtap-swift.

raga.notes: Yaman-only until RAGA-1..3 in DIVERGENCES.md are resolved

trajectory.notes: vibObj sub-schema done (PROP-6 v2 + LEGACY v1); Articulation/Automation are $ref'd to their own schemas

syllable.notes: PROP-8. Reference rules in conformance/syllables.py; fixtures kinds heal, project, rehome, invariants, guard

status: model complete — 12 entities + 3 phoneme packs (0.3.0: PROP-7/8/9 under review)
